confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Colombo price levels, not live listings. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately certain. Hotel anchors, cocktail and wine are less certain, and the Sri Lankan rupee has been volatile. Alcohol prices are high due to taxes. The FX figure comes from a search-result snippet of the RBA page and was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Colombo's local price level as a South Asian capital with a tourism-facing hotel and hostel market, placed above typical regional towns and below Western European capitals. No web search was used for city prices.
